description: Compact readable pixel art inspired by the read-only 8-bit Sprite Assembler reference.
principles: Prioritize silhouette and subject identity at native scale.
Use compact material clusters instead of noisy single-pixel texture.
Keep direction, volume, and grounding consistent.
Animate anatomy and weight rather than sliding a static drawing.
Use restrained contrast accents to focus the face and action.

shape.minimumFeatureRule: A feature must remain readable at 1x or support a larger cluster.

motion.idle: small breathing, posture, tail, ear, or material motion
motion.locomotion: clear contact, passing, and lift phases
motion.attack: readable anticipation, action, impact, and recovery
motion.hurt: brief directional recoil without identity loss
motion.cast: clear origin, buildup, release, and recovery
motion.death: loss of support followed by a readable final resting pose

prohibitions: detail that changes randomly between directions
copying reference pixels as a substitute for drawing the requested subject

references.purpose: quadruped simplification, direction clarity, restrained palette
compact humanoid silhouette and material clusters
